user.title: Elli Charger
user.description: How should Home Assistant talk to the wallbox?

menu_options.modbus: Modbus TCP (Elli Charger 2, recommended: all values)
menu_options.eebus: EEBUS (power limit; Elli Charger 2 and first generation)

modbus.title: Elli Charger 2 (Modbus TCP)
modbus.description: First enable the Modbus server in the wallbox configuration under "Connections > Modbus server" (firmware R03.004.045.121 or later).

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the wallbox

eebus.title: Elli Charger (EEBUS)
eebus.description: The SKI is shown in the wallbox web UI under the EEBUS settings, or found automatically if the wallbox is discovered.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the wallbox

pair.title: Pair with the wallbox
pair.description: In the wallbox web UI ({host}), open the EEBUS settings (Connections > HEMS connection). Under "Found EEBUS devices", select **{our_name}** (SKI {our_ski}) and pair. Then press Submit.

reconfigure.title: Change connection

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the wallbox

reconfigure.description: For EEBUS only host and port can be changed.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Is the Modbus server enabled in the wallbox and the address correct?
error.modbus_error: The wallbox answers, but not with the expected registers. Firmware too old or wrong unit ID?
error.invalid_ski: The SKI must be 40 hexadecimal characters.
error.not_paired: The wallbox did not accept the connection yet. Paired? Then try again.

abort.not_supported: This EEBUS device is not supported.

data_description.scan_interval: Must be well below the wallbox watchdog timeout (default 15 s), otherwise it falls back to the failsafe current.

failsafe_out_of_range.message: Failsafe current must be 0 (stop charging) or at least {min} A.
